answer: Tie every reward to fresh, personalized work instead of to headcount. Each epoch, every agent gets its own task built from a private seed, and random peers grade it. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand names, but each one still has to write its own answer, like a surveyor who must walk every meadow and inlet himself rather than copy one atlas page. Cost grows with every fake identity, while the payout per identity stays flat, so splitting into many agents earns nothing extra.
